prompt: Review an unseen workflow and ML-platform packet. Design and defend workflow identity, scheduling, retry, backfill, experiment lineage, evaluation, registry, feature parity, serving, drift, notebook, security, privacy, capacity, cost and recovery; recover one injected incident; then revise the design after the reviewer changes a major data, label-delay, scale, capacity, compatibility, privacy or cost constraint.
deliverables: Consumer decisions, SLIs, authorities and complete control/execution/evidence map.
Idempotent external effects, bounded retry/deadline, false-green prevention and exact reconciliation.
Backfill workload arithmetic, tightest bottleneck, live reservation, headroom, drain time, waves and pause policy.
Experiment lineage across code, environment, data, features, parameters, metrics, artifacts and evaluation.
Representative evaluation populations, critical slices, labels, baselines, absolute/relative thresholds and approval.
Immutable model version/digest/signature, alias audit, deployment revision, progressive delivery and rollback.
Point-in-time feature correctness, paired online/offline parity and delayed-label feedback.
Serving SLI, failure-capacity calculation, fallback, drift classification and owned response.
Notebook isolation, least privilege, secret handling, privacy copy/retention map, audit and unit cost.
Incident timeline, containment, supported recovery, independent user proof, changed-constraint defense and exact cleanup.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unfamiliar sanitized workflow/run/task/output, experiment/evaluation/model, feature/prediction/label, capacity/policy/audit and cost evidence.
No shared service, real credential, customer data, host network/clock mutation, unbounded backfill/training/load/retention change or unknown cleanup.
Green run state is reconciled against required outputs and consumer outcome.
Unknown task acknowledgement is reconciled by stable operation identity before retry.
Backfill capacity is calculated at the tightest dependency and protects live demand plus headroom.
Every model is connected to immutable code/data/feature/environment/artifact and representative evaluation evidence.
Alias intent and actual deployment/request identity are distinguished.
Feature parity uses same raw facts and historical decision cutoff; drift claims state type and label maturity.
Rollback uses a retained compatible immutable deployment and is proven on requests and user signals.
Notebook and sample evidence follow isolation, access, redaction and retention policy.
Reviewer observes recovery, changed-constraint revision, delayed explanation and exact teardown.
